name: Detection impairment with Condition + NotResource + conditional Deny (boundary)
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: DETECTION-IMPAIRMENT Condition + NotResource + explicit-Deny cells in one witness. Statement 0 allows cloudtrail:StopLogging + guardduty:DeleteDetector on NotResource with a region Condition (still fires; a Condition narrows, it does not remove the grant; NotResource is broad so WILDCARD-RESOURCE is subsumed). Statement 1 is a conditional Deny on cloudtrail:StopLogging which does not definitively suppress the capability but exercises the explicit-Deny interaction.
